# NEW 2026-11-18 round 6 B1, the 1352 civil war. Generated by gen_civil_war_1352.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Marks a once-only event and fires it.
oe_cw2_fire = {
    set_variable = oe_cw2_done_$n$
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.$n$
}

# BYZ scope. Tide: 100 = the Palaiologan side wins, 0 = the Kantakouzenoi win.
oe_cw2_add_tide = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_cw2_tide add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_cw2_tide min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly (main-line scheduler oe_ml_monthly, gen_mainline_lock.py).
oe_cw2_monthly = {
    # Main-line storylines share one monthly lock (gen_mainline_lock.py): the story starts only in a free month.
    if = { limit = { oe_cw2_can_begin = yes oe_ml_free = yes } oe_cw2_begin = yes }
    # The fuse (or a war waiting for another civil war) lapses when its people are gone or the window has passed.
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:oe_cw2_stage ?= 1
            OR = {
                NOT = { character:byz_john_v_palaiologos ?= { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } }
                AND = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 1 NOT = { character:byz_john_kantakouzenos ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } } }
                AND = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 2 NOT = { character:byz_matthaios_kantakouzenos ?= { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } } }
                current_date >= 1365.1.1
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = oe_cw2_lapsed  # r7 F3 hook A: read by the chronicle
        oe_cw2_close = yes
    }
    # A war that had to wait for another civil war to end.
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cw2_pending oe_cw2_war_possible = yes }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cw2_mode ?= 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.7 }
        else = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.8 }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_cw2_stage ?= 2 } oe_cw2_war_monthly = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. The fuse begins.
oe_cw2_begin = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:byz_john_kantakouzenos exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    set_global_variable = oe_cw2_begun
	    set_variable = oe_cw2_active
	    set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_stage value = 1 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_rift value = 30 }
	    if = { limit = { character:byz_john_kantakouzenos = { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } } set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_mode value = 1 } }
	    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_mode value = 2 } }
	    # A Kantakouzenos house above 300 influence widens the rift (as in the 1341 war).
	    if = {
	        limit = {
	            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	                OR = {
	                    AND = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_1 var:oe_nf_dynasty_1 = dynasty:kantakouzenos_dynasty var:oe_nf_influence_1 > 300 }
	                    AND = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_2 var:oe_nf_dynasty_2 = dynasty:kantakouzenos_dynasty var:oe_nf_influence_2 > 300 }
	                    AND = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_3 var:oe_nf_dynasty_3 = dynasty:kantakouzenos_dynasty var:oe_nf_influence_3 > 300 }
	                    AND = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_4 var:oe_nf_dynasty_4 = dynasty:kantakouzenos_dynasty var:oe_nf_influence_4 > 300 }
	                }
	            }
	        }
	        change_variable = { name = oe_cw2_rift add = 10 }
	    }
	    if = { limit = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.1 }
	    else = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.5 }
	}
}

# BYZ scope. End of the fuse: war or concord. If another civil war is being fought, the war waits for it.
oe_cw2_decide = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cw2_rift var:oe_cw2_rift >= 60 }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_cw2_war_possible = yes }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.7 }
            else = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.8 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = oe_cw2_pending }
    }
    else = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.9 }
}

# BYZ scope. The rebel side rises: John V in the Evros valley (mode 1) or Matthew around Adrianople (mode 2).
oe_cw2_war_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:byz_john_v_palaiologos exists = character:byz_matthaios_kantakouzenos }
	    if = {
	        limit = { oe_cw2_war_possible = no }
	        set_variable = oe_cw2_pending
	    }
	    else = {
	        remove_variable = oe_cw2_pending
	        set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_stage value = 2 }
	        set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_wm value = 0 }
	        set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_capm value = 0 }
	        set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_evcd months = 2 }
	        if = {
	            limit = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 1 }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_tide value = 40 }
	            location:demotica = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            location:komotini = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            location:traianopolis = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            location:xanthia = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cw2_jv_land }
	                location:enez = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	                location:kesan = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            }
	            character:byz_john_v_palaiologos = { save_scope_as = oe_cw2_lead }
	            create_rebel = { category = estate estate = nobles_estate name = OE_CW2_REBELS_PAL save_scope_as = oe_cw2_rebel_group }
	        }
	        else = {
	            set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_tide value = 60 }
	            location:edirne = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            location:kirklareli = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            location:luleburgaz = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            location:ahtopol = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            location:kiyikoy = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cw2_mat_land }
	                location:vize = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ is_capital = no } add_to_list = oe_cw2_base } }
	            }
	            character:byz_matthaios_kantakouzenos = { save_scope_as = oe_cw2_lead }
	            create_rebel = { category = estate estate = nobles_estate name = OE_CW2_REBELS_KAN save_scope_as = oe_cw2_rebel_group }
	        }
	        every_in_list = {
	            list = oe_cw2_base
	            every_pop = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } change_pop_allegiance = scope:oe_cw2_rebel_group }
	        }
	        scope:oe_cw2_rebel_group = { start_civil_war = { save_scope_as = oe_cw2_country } }
	        if = {
	            limit = { exists = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_rebels value = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	            every_in_list = { list = oe_cw2_base if = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } change_location_owner = scope:oe_cw2_country } }
	            scope:oe_cw2_lead = { move_country = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	            scope:oe_cw2_country = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_cw2_lead add_gold = 300 }
	            random_in_list = {
	                list = oe_cw2_base
	                limit = { owner = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_infantry owner = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	            }
	            # Disloyal themes that rise join this rebel state (oe_theme_revolt_start joins a theme rebel state at war).
	            # The theme usurpation (oe_theme_usurp_monthly: rebels holding Constantinople 6 months while
	            # oe_theme_revolt_active is set) must not settle this war: this script handles the capital itself.
	            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_revolt_country value = scope:oe_cw2_country }
	            remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
	            remove_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months
	            activate_situation = situation:oe_cw2_war
	            trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_cw2.21 days = 3 }
	        }
	        else = { oe_cw2_concord = yes }
	    }
	}
}

# BYZ scope. The war, monthly.
oe_cw2_war_monthly = {
    # The tide as the month begins: a push to 0 or 100 by an event since last month settles the war now, before this
    # month's drift can pull it back (r13: 100 slipped to 99 and the war went on).
    set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_tide_m0 value = var:oe_cw2_tide }
    change_variable = { name = oe_cw2_wm add = 1 }
    # Themes that rise mid-war join these rebels and set oe_theme_revolt_active again: keep the usurpation counter off.
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country var:oe_theme_revolt_country = var:oe_cw2_rebels }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
        remove_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 1 } change_variable = { name = oe_cw2_tide add = oe_cw2_city_push } }
    else = { change_variable = { name = oe_cw2_tide add = oe_cw2_city_push_neg } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_cw2_tide add = oe_cw2_aid }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_cw2_tide min = 0 max = 100 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_cw2_rebels ?= { has_ruler = yes } location:constantinople = { controller ?= c:BYZ.var:oe_cw2_rebels } } change_variable = { name = oe_cw2_capm add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_capm value = 0 } }
    # Endings first: the Palaiologan side wins, the Kantakouzenoi win, or a divided empire after 4 years.
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                AND = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 1 OR = { var:oe_cw2_tide >= 100 var:oe_cw2_tide_m0 >= 100 var:oe_cw2_capm >= 3 } }
                AND = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 2 OR = { var:oe_cw2_tide >= 100 var:oe_cw2_tide_m0 >= 100 in_civil_war = no } }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_stage value = 3 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.16
        oe_cw2_finish_palaiologan = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                AND = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 1 OR = { var:oe_cw2_tide <= 0 var:oe_cw2_tide_m0 <= 0 in_civil_war = no } }
                AND = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 2 OR = { var:oe_cw2_tide <= 0 var:oe_cw2_tide_m0 <= 0 var:oe_cw2_capm >= 3 } }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_stage value = 3 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.17
        oe_cw2_finish_kantakouzenos = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cw2_wm >= 48 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_stage value = 3 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cw2.18
        oe_cw2_finish_divided = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_ml_free = yes }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cw2_turks ?= 1 has_variable = oe_cw2_serbs NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_done_12 } } oe_cw2_fire = { n = 12 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_evcd } }
            random = {
                chance = 25
                set_variable = { name = oe_cw2_evcd months = 3 }
                random_list = {
            12 = { trigger = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } has_variable = oe_cw2_wm var:oe_cw2_wm >= 2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_done_10 } } oe_cw2_fire = { n = 10 } }
            10 = { trigger = { country_exists = c:SER has_variable = oe_cw2_wm var:oe_cw2_wm >= 3 NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_done_11 } } oe_cw2_fire = { n = 11 } }
            10 = { trigger = { has_variable = oe_cw2_wm var:oe_cw2_wm >= 12 has_variable = oe_cw2_tide var:oe_cw2_tide < 45 NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_done_13 } } oe_cw2_fire = { n = 13 } }
            10 = { trigger = { current_date >= 1354.3.1 country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } OR = { location:gallipoli = { owner ?= c:TUR } c:TUR = { has_variable = gallipoli_earthquake } } NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_done_14 } } oe_cw2_fire = { n = 14 } }
            8 = { trigger = { var:oe_cw2_mode ?= 1 has_variable = oe_cw2_wm var:oe_cw2_wm >= 6 NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_done_15 } } oe_cw2_fire = { n = 15 } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Serbia takes up to 1 place on the Macedonian border.
oe_cw2_serbia_takes = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:SER
            any_owned_location = { OR = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 7 var:oe_theme_region ?= 8 var:oe_theme_region ?= 9 } oe_cw2_key_city = no is_capital = no any_neighbor_location = { owner ?= c:SER } }
        }
        random_owned_location = {
            limit = { OR = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 7 var:oe_theme_region ?= 8 var:oe_theme_region ?= 9 } oe_cw2_key_city = no is_capital = no any_neighbor_location = { owner ?= c:SER } }
            change_location_owner = c:SER
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Hands the rebels' cities back and annexes them while the emperor still reigns, after bringing John V and
# Matthew home (same order as the 1341 war: annexing while the rebels held the capital let the engine settle it).
oe_cw2_end_rebels = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cw2_rebels } var:oe_cw2_rebels = { save_scope_as = oe_cw2_r } }
    character:byz_john_v_palaiologos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { owner = c:BYZ } } move_country = c:BYZ } }
    character:byz_matthaios_kantakouzenos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { owner = c:BYZ } } move_country = c:BYZ } }
    if = {
        limit = { in_civil_war = yes exists = scope:oe_cw2_r }
        every_owned_location = { limit = { controller ?= scope:oe_cw2_r } change_location_controller = c:BYZ }
        annex_country = { country = scope:oe_cw2_r reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. John V alone: after the war (both modes) or by John VI's abdication (mode 1, no war).
oe_cw2_finish_palaiologan = {
    oe_cw2_end_rebels = yes
    character:byz_john_kantakouzenos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } save_scope_as = oe_cw2_k } }
    character:byz_john_v_palaiologos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } save_scope_as = oe_cw2_j5r } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cw2_j5r scope:oe_cw2_j5r = { NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_succession_settled days = 10 } set_new_ruler = scope:oe_cw2_j5r }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cw2_k } scope:oe_cw2_k = { oe_nf_member_influence = { amount = -200 } kill_character_silently = this } }
    add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
    set_global_variable = oe_cw2_palaiologan_won
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SER exists = character:byz_matthaios_kantakouzenos character:byz_matthaios_kantakouzenos = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } } trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_cw2.19 days = 365 } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw2_gattilusio_promised } trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_cw2.20 days = 180 } }
    oe_cw2_close = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The Kantakouzenoi keep the crown.
oe_cw2_finish_kantakouzenos = {
    oe_cw2_end_rebels = yes
    character:byz_matthaios_kantakouzenos ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } save_scope_as = oe_cw2_m } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_cw2_m }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 1 } set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_cw2_m }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_succession_settled days = 10 } set_new_ruler = scope:oe_cw2_m scope:oe_cw2_m = { oe_nf_member_influence = { amount = 200 } } }
    }
    add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
    set_global_variable = oe_cw2_kantakouzenos_won
    oe_cw2_close = yes
}
# BYZ scope. A divided empire: the rebels' towns return, a long malaise follows.
oe_cw2_finish_divided = {
    oe_cw2_end_rebels = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_cw2_mode = 1 exists = character:byz_john_v_palaiologos character:byz_john_v_palaiologos = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ } }
        character:byz_john_v_palaiologos = { save_scope_as = oe_cw2_j5h }
        set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_cw2_j5h
    }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw2_divided years = 10 mode = replace }
    oe_cw2_close = yes
}
# BYZ scope. No war.
oe_cw2_concord = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw2_concord years = 10 mode = replace }
    oe_cw2_close = yes
}

# BYZ scope. Common clean-up; the scars of the war last longer the longer it ran.
oe_cw2_close = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cw2_stage var:oe_cw2_stage >= 2 has_variable = oe_cw2_wm }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_cw2_wm < 24 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw_scars years = 5 mode = replace } }
        else = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw_scars years = 10 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_cw2_rebels has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country var:oe_theme_revolt_country = var:oe_cw2_rebels }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_country
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active
        remove_variable = oe_theme_usurp_months
    }
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_active
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_stage
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_rebels
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_turks
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_turks_short
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_serbs
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_genoa
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_venice
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_pending
    remove_variable = oe_cw2_tide_m0
    set_global_variable = oe_cw2_done
}
